# Capability matrix

<!-- Generated by scripts/misc/gen_capability_matrix.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

This matrix is derived from `reverselab_mcp/registry.py`. Every operation is a native adapter; some adapters delegate to an optional external CLI. Live tool availability is environment-specific and is reported by `scripts/misc/lab_healthcheck.py`, not checked in here.

## External tools

| Tool | Optional | Used by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tshark` | yes | `pcap_summary`, `pcap_extract_http` |
| `ilspycmd` | yes | `dotnet_list_types`, `dotnet_decompile_type` |
| WABT (`wasm-objdump`, `wasm2wat`) | yes | `wasm_info` |

## Tool profiles

| Profile | Tools | Families | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `legacy` | 131 | android:30, common:30, crypto:6, general-format:6, pe:49, web:10 | Every registered tool. Backward-compatible default during migration. |
| `common` | 30 | common:30 | Intake, triage, workspace, toolbox, engine status. |
| `ctf` | 40 | common:30, web:10 | Web/HTTP/CTF surface plus common. |
| `pe` | 85 | common:30, crypto:6, pe:49 | PE/ELF static, dynamic, patch, IOC surface plus common. |
| `apk` | 66 | android:30, common:30, crypto:6 | Android static, Frida, and crypto surface plus common. |
| `general` | 42 | common:30, crypto:6, general-format:6 | Crypto, protocol, pcap, .NET, WASM surface plus common. |

## Notes

- `legacy` is the default profile and keeps the pre-registry catalog intact.
- An absent external tool must produce a `missing_engine` envelope, never a silent empty result.
